scope: Explicit read-only NVMe IRQ/completion evidence in Spectra STORAGE.

implementation.ownership: Spectra owns selection and common output. Native storage owns exact device pin, one resident sector, native ticket and BSP controller retirement. NVME.R4D remains hardware/CQE/IRQ/DMA owner; no second device stack.
implementation.identity: The existing logical read and wait share optional resident observation metadata; normal requests retain null observer and the unchanged56-byte flags0 public request. The diagnostic sends an80-byte observed request only to an advertised capable backend. It matches the exact native request/backend handle against the104-byte synchronous driver witness.
implementation.success: Actual own CQE, controller/namespace generations, queue and command IDs, IRQ generation and worker pass, complete sector payload, one callback, no cancel/timeout/epoch change or polling path. A shared/coalesced IRQ is not claimed exclusively for this command. Passive per-device counters and historical driver status cannot establish success.
implementation.lifetime: Caller output never enters a worker. Resident subscription, sector and exact device pin survive real completion/cancel. Partial or uncertain work retains the resident session/gate. The controller uses the existing last-pin task resource/metadata retirement ledger.
implementation.dma_correction: Previously NVMe ignored unmap/unpin return values and decremented owned_count before actual release. The shared production cleanup now requires successful returns and cleared descriptors, keeps owned_count until exact slot retirement, closes admission and retains resources/callback on missing acknowledgment. Recovery/shutdown cannot clear that slot or claim safe release.
implementation.api: Append-only R4DEVv19 slot53@440, total448, fixed296-byte v1 report. Contract0.64.16/SDK0.64.28 published exact pins; old public type bodies/constants/slots and440-byte prefix unchanged.
implementation.boot_boundary: Existing /NVME and default STORAGE, isolated boot NVMEIRQ/NVMEIRQPROBE and Quick assertions remain unchanged. They also test old56-byte flags0 reads against the new driver. New scoped guests disable SMP boot selftest, so their own read cannot borrow boot evidence.
implementation.reset_observation: Reset can finish a previously submitted command without an own CQE. The driver does not infer or publish not_submitted from that absence; supported result/cancel/epoch and CQE facts remain separate.
